Sourcerer.io, My Github account in Colors!!

2020-07-11

I promise myself write a post about Laravel, and probably I should (I’ll do in a couples days, promise). But I found this website Sourcerer.io so I wanted to write about it. I love when the UI of a website in simple and clear. Of course this is a website for programmers and probably is not going to the website of the month in Awwwards but I really like it.

It shows what it is been typed and uploaded to your Gihub account. I love when they use a different color for each language, let me to distinguish better.

This is my profile marialobillo, yeah, could be better, but It’s what I’ve been doing last 5 years or so.

I didn’t remember that I was working with so many tools. I love it!
